title: PAY-002 Commerce Order API Candidate Admission Gate
purpose: Admission gate for the candidate Commerce Order create/read DTOs; it is not a canonical evidence registry entry and does not enable public routes.

requiredEvidence.requirement: Both candidate methods and exact paths are added to Canonical OpenAPI with closed request/response DTO schemas, common error envelopes and body size limits.
order.create.own and order.read.own are admitted to contracts/authz/permissions.json and CASL/role policy with owner scope; unauthorized and cross-owner reads are rejected.
W07 resolves every submitted itemRef to an authoritative purchasable item/offer, immutable version and current price; unsupported/unavailable items fail closed.
Create/read response DTO fields map deterministically to ENT-ORDER and ENT-ORDER-LINE without exposing customerId, internal columns, raw provider data, ledger rows or entitlement snapshots.
Read-only D1-04 UUID/display-name preflight and reviewed physical schema/migration evidence pass before runtime writes are enabled.
Same key and same semantic request replays the original response; same key with a different request hash is rejected atomically with order creation.
Route enforces bounded request-body size, item-count/quantity limits and existing W01/W07 anti-abuse controls before any D1 write.
Exact-commit tests cover create/read, malformed/unknown fields, price spoofing, missing key, replay/key-reuse conflict, owner isolation, unavailable items, concurrency and recovery.
Schema, migration, security and runtime evidence is admitted against the exact implementation commit; PAY-002 stays unresolved until downstream mapping checks pass.

greenRule: This candidate gate cannot be GREEN while any evidence is PENDING; route publication and implementation admission are separate from a valid candidate DTO.
nextAction: Admit permission identifiers and canonical OpenAPI/operation-policy mapping, then implement through W01 public API boundary to W07.
